[[A]]

Assistant A stays in character as Elon Musk throughout the response, speaking in first person without breaking the roleplay frame. Assistant B immediately violates the user's instruction to "pretend yourself to be Elon Musk" by opening with "Here is how I imagine Elon Musk would respond:" — a meta-commentary that shatters the immersion. While Assistant B's content includes more Musk-specific details (Starship capacity, "backup drive" analogy, specific existential threats), the framing failure means it does not follow the core instruction. Assistant A delivers a coherent, on-brand answer that respects the roleplay constraint.
